## Quick key

**0.1 Presentation:** K = Knowledge, T = Thinking, C = Communication, V = Visuals & accessibility, A = Application. Each is /2.

**0.2 Listening flags:** PH = phone, TK = talking/side conversation, OF = off-task/not facing, NN = not taking notes, PR = prompted/reminded. Mark a flag only when observed. A blank flag means no concern was observed.

**Learning Skills:** R = Responsibility, O = Organization, IW = Independent Work, C = Collaboration, I = Initiative, SR = Self-Regulation.

Enter the final **0.2 /10** after reviewing the student's submitted listening notes, Listening Reflection, Learning Skills self-evaluation, and Presentation Reflection.
